rationale: C02 is an exceptionally close predecessor and plausibly supplied the child’s drafting template. It uses the same opening tax-return enumeration, the same House Committee on Government Operations and authorized-subcommittee recipient, the same government-activity studies and economy-and-efficiency purpose, the same Treasury-decision condition, and the same Federal Register effectiveness clause. The child principally updates the cutoff year from 1952 to 1954, the Congress from the Eighty-third to the Eighty-fourth, and the formulation of the applicable Treasury rules. C19 and C10 share much of the same machinery and purpose but concern Senate committees and are less exact templates.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared-value excess-profits, capital-stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1954
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1952
shared_material.explanation: Nearly identical enumeration and temporal structure, with the cutoff year updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall, during the Eighty-fourth Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on Government Operations, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall, during the Eighty-third Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on Government Operations, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.explanation: The operative authorization is virtually verbatim, changing only the congressional term.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining the economy and efficiency of the Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining its economy and efficiency
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive statement of investigative purpose appears with only a minor grammatical revision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the two Treasury decisions
shared_material.parent_excerpt: subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision ... relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee
shared_material.explanation: Both condition inspection on contemporaneously approved Treasury rules; the child updates and expands the formulation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.
shared_material.explanation: The same concluding effectiveness provision reinforces the parallel drafting structure.
